title: Peer-to-Peer Ticket Sale
scenario: A student sells festival tickets but refuses buyer protection or in-person verification.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Peer-to-Peer Ticket Sale: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Use protected payment and official ticket transfer systems.
